definitions.explanation: A way through or along which people can walk. A path or walkway connecting two areas.
A walkway between rows of seats or shelves.

examples.japanese: {通路|つうろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{通路|つうろ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{暗|くら}くて→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧。
examples.english: This passageway is dark and narrow.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通路|つうろ}⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ (aisle side)
- ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ (window side - opposite)
- ⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧{通路|つうろ} (emergency passage)
- ⟦{地下|ちか}→地下：03429_chika⟧{通路|つうろ} (underground passage)
- {通路|つうろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塞|ふさ}ぐ→塞ぐ：00046_fusagu⟧ (to block the aisle)

TRAVEL USAGE:
